data.title: Meter reading and smoke alarm maintenance in January
data.summary: The property management (Hausverwaltung Muster & Partner) proposes access dates of 12, 14 or 16 January 2026 (8 am–12 pm) for reading heat cost allocators and servicing smoke alarms. You are asked to reply within 7 working days of the letter date (22 December 2025).
data.explanation: Your building's owners' association will have the heating meters (Heizkostenverteiler) read and the smoke alarms (Rauchwarnmelder) serviced in January. Three time slots are offered: 12, 14 or 16 January 2026, between 8 am and 12 pm. Tell the property management which slot suits you, so someone can be in your flat. Reply by the deadline shown, using the phone number or email on the letter. Otherwise access to your flat may not be arranged and the work may have to be rescheduled.
